notes.title: Same Artist, New Game.
notes.notes:

notes.title: V1.5 Epilogues & Achievement
notes.notes:
We are now happy to launch the version 1.5 update, this adds the much awaited bonus epilogues to the game. By completing the Ryn and Yui ending you will gain access to the epilogues afterwards.

There are a couple of epilogues, a thoughtful one, a ryn and yui one and perhaps a harem one...

Finally some additional CG scenes have been added in both censored and uncensored versions of the game.

In addition by popular request we have added an achievement to the game.

P.s. last but not least it also adds an extra track to the soundtrack dlc.

Enjoy.
All is now live.
